name: investigation
summary: A read-only question. Answer it from the graph and the repository, not from memory.

steps.title: Build or refresh the map before you read anything
steps.done_when: The graph is current for this working tree.

steps.title: Ask the graph, not your memory
steps.done_when: You can name who depends on the thing you are asking about. Use `hexa graph explain` or `hexa graph context` when the question is about one node.

steps.title: Test the claim you are about to make
steps.run: hexa verify "<the claim you are about to state>"
steps.done_when: The verdict is CONFIRMED or REFUTED against gathered evidence. INCONCLUSIVE means you report it as unknown, not as true.

steps.title: Record what you learned, before you forget it
steps.run: hexa memory store lesson:<topic> "<what you learned>"
steps.done_when: The lesson is stored, or the answer was not worth keeping.

steps.title: Prove the investigation changed nothing
steps.done_when: The grade is exactly what it was before you started. An investigation that moves the grade edited something.
